cds.title: University of Washington Bothell Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF)

ipeds.title: IPEDS via NCES College Navigator: fall 2024 admissions considerations and campus setting

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2025 first-year class, read from the PDF's fillable fields): 2,704 men + 2,904 women + 8 unknown = 5,616 applicants; 4,852 admitted (86%); 1,157 enrolled. Residency: in-state 4,585 applied / 4,067 admitted / 1,126 enrolled; out-of-state 982 / 740 / 16; international 49 / 45 / 15 (92% admitted). UW Bothell has an early action plan (Nov 15) and a waitlist. Undergraduate enrollment 5,753 and 139 nonresident undergraduates are the enrollment totals. The SAT range comes from the 14.8% (172) of enrolled first-years who submitted SAT; UW Bothell is test-optional, so it is not an admission benchmark. SAT ERW/Math and ACT percentiles are fractional in the Common Data Set and are not shown. The admission-factor checkboxes could not be mapped reliably, so admission factors are not shown.

cds_test_policy.notes: The Common Data Set answers 'No' to using SAT/ACT in admission decisions; the admissions FAQ says scores are not required and welcome to be sent with no advantage or disadvantage.
